thread:
neel: Quick FYI  spotted a drift between the Console 'Latency vs Cost' example and the live metric names after the telemetry rename. The example uses `latency_ms` + `cost_usd` but runtime now emits `p95_latency_ms` and `cost_estimate_usd`. Preview failed to render in the doc playground.
tara: Ah yes, that explains the mismatched numbers in the sample table. We should update the example and add a small note explaining the new metric naming convention.
ben: I'll open a tiny PR. Plan: 1) update the example table, 2) add an anchor `#metric-name-changes`, 3) include a Python snippet showing how to map old names to new in a metric-export pipeline.
neel: For the Python snippet please keep it compact (2-3 lines) and use the official helper: `from redwood.telemetry import rename_metrics
rename_metrics(event, {"latency_ms": "p95_latency_ms", "cost_usd": "cost_estimate_usd"})`.
tara: Also add a jq one-liner for ops: `jq '(.metrics|=with_entries(if .key=="latency_ms" then .key="p95_latency_ms" elif .key=="cost_usd" then .key="cost_estimate_usd" else . end))'`  mark as experimental.
ben: Will add both. docs-bot: lint/links-checker started for PR #10199
ben: Small gotcha: the example's frontmatter forgot `presets: true` and example-sniffer will fail. Fixing that in the same commit.
qa-bot: example-sniffer job reports failing example `latency-cost-sample`  missing `presets` frontmatter.
ben: Fixed frontmatter and pushed. docs-bot: running example-sniffer
neel: Could we also include a short worked example showing how cost attribution changes when switching from per-request to per-token billing? Readers keep asking. Maybe a tiny table with formulas: `cost = tokens * unit_price` and a note about batching effects.
tara: Good idea. Add a short paragraph: "When batching, attributed tokens may differ from raw tokens processed; multiply observed by avg_batch_size for estimates."
ben: Added table + note. docs-bot: build started for PR #10199
ben: One more: accessibility flagged missing alt text on `latency-cost-heatmap.png`. Added alt `Heatmap of 95th percentile latency vs estimated cost across models`.
qa-bot: All examples/render checks passed for PR #10199
docs-bot: PR #10199 merged by ben  all CI green.
neel: Can we file a follow-up to add a Node snippet and an automated check that validates metric name mappings during a docs release?
tara: Filed GH issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4177 and assigned to ben + neel. Closing thread.
